note: Sweet Year Table. Foods and their wishes. The apple in honey and the round challah are from the calendar day page for Rosh Hashanah (data/calendar/days.json customs); the pomegranate, the head and the new fruit are widely kept customs that the app does not state yet, so each carries a review note. The head line quotes Deuteronomy 28:13 from the app's Torah text. Decoys are foods of other holidays from the same day pages.

foods.wish: a whole, full year: the challah is baked round
good deeds as many as its seeds
